Question
========
In the elephant curve for 1988 to 2008, who gained most in relative terms (point A)?

Answerlist
----------
* The emerging middle classes in Asia, above all in China
* The lower middle classes in Western Europe and North America
* The poorest 5% of the world
* Nobody; all groups grew equally

Solution
========
Point A, around the median of the global distribution, marks relative gains of 70 to 80%, mostly in the new middle classes of Asia.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
